I wrote the review to `.social-review.md`. All three platforms fail a hard rule, so the file includes repaired copy for each.

- **X:** FAIL for bold markdown (`**coding**`). The repair drops the asterisks, and the copy is now 250 of 255 characters.
- **LinkedIn:** FAIL for the banned phrase "excited to announce". The repair drops that opening sentence, and the copy is now about 1188 of 2950 characters. I counted that by hand and did not run the character-count check.
- **Bluesky:** FAIL because the copy is a single paragraph and needs two. The repair splits it after "matters." with the wording unchanged, and the copy is now 264 of 300 characters.

I did not run the sub-agent critique pass on the repaired copy. I also skipped the advisory suggestions pass, because every platform needed a repair. The file has no advisory section.

I did not read the blog post itself. The review rests on the hard rules in the critique rubric. I did not check the copy's claims against the article. I did not post a PR comment.
